source.citation: Axis-aligned bounding box of LILYGO's vendor STEP model '3D_PCB_T-CameraPlus-S3_V1.2_202505091545.step' (sha256 b5ac26860e33f3bd993dd62b1d48909a6dc07cad7c528cfb54852ad20fbb9487, 68,603,684 bytes, from github.com/Xinyuan-LilyGO/T-CameraPlus-S3 structure/ at commit 55764fa22a0dd2ea66715b2b5dc403a34569ba42), computed 2026-09-11 with OCCT 7.9.3 (cadquery-ocp 7.9.3.1.1) BRepBndLib::AddOptimal after 0.05 mm incremental meshing; the STEP declares MM. Extents 29.9999 x 69.6625 x 10.8643 mm in the model's own frame, which is board-aligned with Z as the board normal (no axis permutation applied); rounded up to 0.01. Z runs from the lowest underside feature (4.71 mm below the model's z=0) to the tallest top-side component; the model carries no pin headers. This is the **V1.2** hardware revision (2025-04, per the repo README's version table); a separate STEP exists for V1.0-V1.1 (3D_PCB_T-CameraPlus-S3_V1.0-V1.1_202505091545.step) and was not measured. The STEP is the only dimensional source: the V1.2 schematic (T-CameraPlus-S3_V1.2_20240417.pdf, sha256 5363097ad586a5bf21cdd528fa8c0213b08e6af951835b1f8533531a64a202e2) is electrical only, and neither the README nor lilygo.cc's product page states board dimensions. The product page also lists an OV5640 SKU (H703-01); the model's camera module is not identified in the file, so the OV5640 variant's height is unverified. What the model does say, from a census of all 825 solids (BRepBndLib::Add, coarse boxes, 2026-09-12): the extreme z faces belong to exactly two features. The top is a single solid 6.2995 x 6.0000 x 5.0000 mm spanning z 1.1412 to 6.1412 -- SW3, the 6 x 6 mm tactile switch (named in the per-component census of 2026-09-26; this note said 'a lens-barrel shape' until then, which was a guess from geometry and wrong), the tallest thing on the board by 1.80 mm over the next component (8.9500 x 7.4500 x 4.2000 mm, reaching 4.3412). The bottom is -4.7100. Those two numbers are the whole of z: 6.1412 - (-4.7100) = 10.8512, rounded up to 10.87. **Neither vendor model contains the camera module or the display at all** (established 2026-09-26 by naming every solid in both the V1.2 and V1.0-V1.1 files), so this envelope is the populated PCB only, not the board as fitted: a V1.1 board with its lens and display measures 29.40 mm deep (calipers, 2026-09-25). The OV5640 question cannot be settled from these models either way, and no vendor publishes the module height -- LILYGO's product page, the repo README and the resellers' listings were all checked on 2026-09-12 and none states one. For where the connectors are, and what the models leave out, see features (ADR-0007).

Per-component bounding boxes of LILYGO's vendor STEP model '3D_PCB_T-CameraPlus-S3_V1.0-V1.1_202505091545.step' (57,412,708 bytes, from github.com/Xinyuan-LilyGO/T-CameraPlus-S3 structure/ at commit 55764fa22a0dd2ea66715b2b5dc403a34569ba42), computed 2026-09-26 by scripts/extract_step_features.py with OCCT 7.9.3 (cadquery-ocp 7.9.3.1.1): STEPCAFControl_Reader, one box per placed component instance (the union of its bodies, full assembly location applied), BRepBndLib::AddOptimal on exact geometry, rounded to 0.001 mm; the run is byte-identical on repeat. Silkscreen and copper layers are excluded as zero-thickness artwork. This is the V1.0-V1.1 model because the bench board is V1.1; the V1.2 model used for envelope_mm differs where it matters for fit - laminate 1.14 mm instead of 1.20, CN4 and LED1 about 1 mm further from the y = 0 edge, and a slide switch (SW4) overhanging the x = 0 edge that V1.1 does not have - while USB1, CN1, CN2, CN3, CN5, FPC1, RF1, U1 and CARD1 occupy the same x-y footprint in both. Access directions marked 'inferred' are read off the geometry and are not confirmations; every depth is unknown until measured or cited.

features.frame: The STEP model's own frame, unmodified. x across the board (laminate 0.007 to 27.981); y along it, with the edge carrying USB1, CN1 and CN2 at y = 0.016 (laminate to 67.990); z the board normal, z = 0 being the laminate face carrying FPC1, U1 and CN3 and z = 1.200 the face carrying USB1, CN1, CN2, SW3 and CARD1. Millimetres; the STEP declares MM.
not_modelled: The camera module and lens: neither vendor STEP contains them. The bench board's barrel measures 14.95 mm diameter with 5.10 mm free length to a 16.65 mm lip, tip 24 mm from the PCB face, axis 35.00 mm from the y = 0 edge (calipers, 2026-09-25); its position across the board and which face it stands on are not yet recorded, so it is not an item.
The display and whatever backs it: not in either model (U11 marks only its connector footprint). The bench board measures 29.40 mm overall depth (calipers, 2026-09-25) against this model's 10.91 mm.
Permanently attached cables - the camera FPC, and a twisted pair observed exiting one long edge of the bench board on 2026-09-25 - are not modelled as paths.
